scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:reproducible && npm run check && npm test && npm run test:python
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && npm run prepare:deploy && wrangler deploy --config .local/deploy/site.wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:api: npm run build && npm run prepare:deploy && wrangler deploy --config .local/deploy/api.wrangler.json
scripts.format: prettier --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "{backend,public/assets,scripts,tests}/**/*.{js,mjs,css}" "templates/*.html" package.json .prettierrc.json wrangler.jsonc backend/wrangler.jsonc eslint.config.mjs "README*.md" "../README*.md" "../{CONTRIBUTING,SECURITY,NOTICE}.md" "../docs/**/*.md" "../.github/**/*.yml" && python3 -m ruff format scripts tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "{backend,public/assets,scripts,tests}/**/*.{js,mjs,css}" "templates/*.html" package.json .prettierrc.json wrangler.jsonc backend/wrangler.jsonc eslint.config.mjs "README*.md" "../README*.md" "../{CONTRIBUTING,SECURITY,NOTICE}.md" "../docs/**/*.md" "../.github/**/*.yml" && python3 -m ruff format --check scripts tests
scripts.lint: eslint backend public/assets scripts tests eslint.config.mjs && python3 -m ruff check scripts tests
